latest_update.text: Salam, Context. MedStation patients are now receiving automated messages from two systems at once. Neuryn sends its own appointment reminders, and GoHighLevel has started sending review requests, missed call replies and reactivation prompts. At the team onboarding call on 4 September this came out as a live risk on two fronts: patients getting duplicated or conflicting messages, and conversations splitting across two channels so staff never see a whole thread in one place. Step one, get the Neurin flows. Coordinate with Rafael at Neuryn to obtain the exact appointment reminder messages Neuryn sends, including their timing, their triggers and their language, and share them with the team so MedStation can approve the wording. Nothing here can be judged until the actual copy is in front of us
